newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE issues first death sentence in a drugs case.
newsitem.headline: UAE issues first death sentence in a drugs case.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates issued a death sentence in a drugs case against one of its nationals, the first since a federal narcotics law took effect in 1995, local newspapers reported on Sunday.
"The (criminal) court awarded a death sentence...to a UAE national, who was convicted of drug trafficking and addiction," the English-language Gulf Today quoted a court official as saying.
It said the UAE Criminal Investigation Department seized 3.26 kg (7.19 pounds) of opium that the convict had hidden in his daughter's house.
The man confessed to trafficking and addiction charges, the paper added.
A court official told Reuters the sentence could be appealed at higher courts. Death sentences in the UAE should also be endorsed by the President, Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan.
Executions in the UAE are usually by firing squad.
